content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling digital products like Notion templates for cryptocurrency represents a shift in how creators manage commerce. Traditional platforms often impose steep fees, like Gumroad's 10% on each sale, which quickly adds up and eats into your profits. By utilizing a decentralized approach with tools such as NOWPayments, which only charges 0.5%, you retain more of your earnings. This is especially crucial for creators who need to maximize their income while delivering value to their customers.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for selling Notion templates involves a combination of free and paid tools that work together seamlessly. Using platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting ensures that your store is always accessible. In tandem, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can handle the backend logic, automating processes like order confirmation and product delivery. NOWPayments integrates directly, allowing you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees and no KYC requirements, creating a frictionless buying experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is tailored for digital creators in countries where major payment processors are either unavailable or charge exorbitant fees. If you're in Nigeria, Kenya, or Venezuela, and you want to sell digital products without being locked out by conventional platforms, this architecture gives you the tools to build an independent store. It empowers you to reach a global audience while retaining complete ownership of your data and products, giving you the freedom to scale your business.
Keep more of your profits by minimizing fees with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The architecture consists of several key components: website hosting through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automated delivery via Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, order management through Supabase or Google Sheets, and payment processing handled by NOWPayments. Each component plays a critical role in ensuring that your digital store runs smoothly. When combined, they create a robust system that eliminates reliance on third-party platforms, allowing you to focus on your creativity and business growth.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Getting started with selling Notion templates for crypto is straightforward. First, choose your hosting solution; GitHub Pages is a reliable option. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers to process orders. Integrate NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrency payments. Finally, ensure you have a method for product delivery, whether through Google Drive or another platform. The entire setup can be accomplished quickly, allowing you to start selling your templates and earning revenue almost immediately.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using infrastructure that supports crypto payments. Platforms like NOWPayments allow you to accept a variety of cryptocurrencies, which circumvents the need for traditional payment processors. This not only reduces fees but also broadens your sales potential in regions where conventional payment systems are restricted.
Automate product delivery to enhance customer experience.

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

You can use NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments directly, allowing customers to purchase your ebook using various cryptocurrencies. This method bypasses the need for traditional payment processors while keeping transaction fees low.

Utilizing a decentralized infrastructure with tools like GitHub Pages and NOWPayments can help you sell digital downloads without incurring high platform fees. This allows you to retain a larger portion of your sales revenue.

Yes, by creating your own store using GitHub Pages for hosting and integrating NOWPayments for payments, you can sell templates and fonts without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What are the benefits of using cryptocurrency for sales?

Cryptocurrency transactions often have lower fees compared to traditional payment processors, allowing you to keep more profit. Additionally, crypto payments can be processed quickly, providing a better experience for your customers.
How do I deliver products automatically after a sale?

You can use automation tools like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to deliver your products automatically once a transaction is confirmed through NOWPayments. This ensures a seamless experience for your customers.
